prompt: How are central-bank interest-rate decisions in 2026 affecting mortgage markets?
report:
# Central-Bank Rates and Mortgage Markets in 2026

## Rate path
Through the first half of 2026 the central bank held its policy rate elevated to keep inflation anchored near the 2% target [S1][S2]. Markets price two cuts in the second half if core inflation continues to ease [S2].

## Mortgage impact
Higher policy rates feed into the 30-year fixed mortgage, which stayed above 6.5% for most of the period [S3]. Mortgage application volume fell as affordability tightened, and refinancing largely stalled [S3][S4].

## Outlook
A pivot to cuts would lower the mortgage rate with a lag of one to two quarters; until inflation cools convincingly, the central bank is expected to stay restrictive [S2][S5].

[S2] https://www.bloomberg.com/inflation-outlook-2026
